D.O.T.S. Projector.strategyNotes: Tier 3's wide scanning spotlight is significantly more effective for covering large rooms like the Brownstone High School gym.

Tier3.notes: Maximum range and instant response. Best for quick evidence gathering.

EMF Reader.strategyNotes: Place an EMF reader near the fuse box to catch a Jinn's sanity-draining ability, which leaves a reading.

Tier1.notes: Basic. Requires ghost to be in the same room.

Spirit Box.strategyNotes: Always ask questions in a lit room to preserve sanity. A successful response from a Moroi can curse you, doubling passive sanity drain.

Ghost Writing Book.strategyNotes: Higher tiers are crucial for large maps, as the ghost must be within the book's range to interact.

Video Camera.strategyNotes: Essential for catching a Goryo's D.O.T.S. evidence, which is only visible through a camera feed. Can also be placed on a Tripod.

UV Light.strategyNotes: Check for a six-fingered handprint to instantly identify an Obake. Fingerprints fade twice as fast for this ghost.

Tier3.notes: Instant and most precise. Essential for finding the ghost room quickly.

Thermometer.strategyNotes: A Hantu's speed is directly tied to temperature; keeping the fuse box on and the location warm can significantly slow it down.

Crucifix.strategyNotes: Crucifixes only prevent a hunt from starting; they do not stop an active hunt. A Demon's crucifix range is 50% larger than a standard ghost's.

Tier1.effect: Blinds ghost for 5s during a hunt.

Tier2.effect: Blinds ghost for 6s during a hunt.

Tier3.effect: Stops ghost movement for 5s during a hunt.

Smudge Sticks (Incense).strategyNotes: Use during a hunt to break line-of-sight and escape. A Spirit's smudge timer is 180 seconds (double the normal 90), while a Demon's is only 60 seconds.

Lighter (Igniter).strategyNotes: Required to light Smudge Sticks and Candles.

Flashlight.strategyNotes: An active flashlight can be detected by a Yokai during a hunt. A Raiju also speeds up when near active electronics.

Head Gear.strategyNotes: Frees up a hand slot, allowing you to carry two items while maintaining light.

Parabolic Microphone.notes: Detects paranormal sounds from a distance. Can catch the Banshee's unique scream and a Moroi's curse.
Parabolic Microphone.strategyNotes: Use to locate the ghost room on large maps. A Banshee's scream or a Moroi's curse can be heard through this device.

Sound Recorder.notes: Records and plays back paranormal sounds. Can catch the Banshee's scream.
Sound Recorder.strategyNotes: A specialized tool for confirming a Banshee.

Tier1.notes: Wall-mounted. Detects players and ghosts. Map shows a line.

Tier2.notes: Wall-mounted. Map shows a cone. Audible alert.

Tier3.notes: Floor-mountable. Detects only ghosts. Map shows a circle.

Motion Sensor.strategyNotes: Tier 3 sensors are invaluable for tracking a ghost's roaming path without false alarms from players.

Tripod.strategyNotes: Allows you to place a Video Camera for remote monitoring, freeing up a hand slot.

Sanity Pills.effect: Restores sanity based on difficulty: Beginner (40%), Intermediate (35%), Professional (30%), Nightmare (25%).

Tier3.notes: 10-second consumption time. Instantly refills stamina and maintains it for 10 seconds.

Sanity Pills.strategyNotes: Removes a Moroi's curse. Tier 3 pills are a lifesaver during a chase.

Salt.effect: Ghosts that step in salt leave UV footprints and are slowed during a hunt. Can force the ghost to cancel an ability.
Salt.strategyNotes: The Wraith never steps in salt. Place salt at chokepoints to confirm a Wraith or to leave a trail for a Revenant.

Candle.effect: Provides a small light source. Within 2m, it slows sanity drain. Acts as a crucifix against the Onryo.
Candle.strategyNotes: A lit candle will be blown out by an Onryo instead of allowing a hunt. Three blowouts with no other flames nearby can trigger a hunt at any sanity level.

commonRules.spawnChance: 1 in 7 per contract on default difficulties.
commonRules.setupPhase: Using any cursed possession immediately cancels the setup phase.
commonRules.inventory: Cannot be stored. Requires a free hand.
commonRules.photographValue: Up to $7 and 7 XP per photograph.

cursedHunt.description: A special hunt triggered by most cursed possessions.
rules: Hunt duration increases by 20 seconds for every subsequent cursed hunt in the contract.
Cannot be prevented by Smudge Sticks.
counters: Tier III Crucifix with both charges intact.
Exiting the building before triggering (cancels the hunt, but the 20s duration penalty still applies).

Monkey Paw.effect: Grants wishes via voice chat. Number of wishes depends on difficulty.

I wish to see the ghost.effect: Triggers a full manifestation event in the ghost's current room.

I wish for activity.effect: Doubles all ghost activity for 2 minutes.
I wish for activity.penalty: None directly, but increased activity raises hunt risk.

I wish to be sane.penalty: Passive sanity drain increases by 1.5x for the rest of the contract.

I wish to be safe.effect: Unlocks the nearest locked hiding spot.

I wish to leave.penalty: Player's movement speed is reduced for the rest of the contract.

I wish to revive my friend.penalty: The wisher has a 50% chance of dying.

I wish for knowledge.effect: Reveals the ghost's type in the journal.
I wish for knowledge.penalty: Ghost's hunt sanity threshold is lowered for the rest of the contract.

Monkey Paw.strategyNotes: 'I wish to be safe' is a low-risk wish that can create an escape route. Avoid 'I wish to see the ghost' unless you are prepared for an immediate cursed hunt.

Voodoo Doll.effect: Has 10 pins. Each interaction pushes in one pin and forces the ghost to interact with the environment.
Voodoo Doll.sanityCost: 5% per normal pin; 10% for the heart pin.
Voodoo Doll.cursedHuntTrigger: Pushing the heart pin triggers a cursed hunt. Also triggers if used at 0% sanity.
Voodoo Doll.strategyNotes: Forced interactions can produce EMF Level 5 and Ultraviolet evidence. Excellent for identifying shy ghosts like the Shade.

Ouija Board.effect: Allows direct communication with the ghost. The planchette spells out answers.
Ouija Board.cursedHuntTrigger: Saying 'Hide and Seek' guarantees a countdown to a hunt. Leaving the board active and moving more than 5m away causes it to burn and trigger a cursed hunt. Asking a question that costs more sanity than you have triggers a cursed hunt.
Ouija Board.strategyNotes: Always say 'Goodbye' to deactivate safely. Each answer has a 33% chance of producing EMF Level 5 if the ghost has that evidence.

Music Box.effect: Plays music. If the ghost is within 20m, it sings, revealing its location. Within 5m, triggers a ghost event where the ghost walks toward the box.
Music Box.sanityCost: 2.6% per second within 3m of the active box (up to 77% over the full 30-second melody).
Music Box.cursedHuntTrigger: Dropping (not placing) the box while music plays; ghost comes within 1m of the box; ghost walks for more than 5 seconds during the event; using at 0% sanity.
Music Box.strategyNotes: The Spirit can teleport onto the person carrying an active Music Box. Have a plan to drop it and run.

Haunted Mirror.effect: Shows a live view of the ghost's favorite room, including lights and equipment.
Haunted Mirror.sanityCost: 7.5% per second, with a minimum of 20% per activation.
Haunted Mirror.cursedHuntTrigger: Using it below 20% sanity, or if sanity reaches 0% while looking into it (the mirror shatters).
Haunted Mirror.strategyNotes: Extremely useful on maps with similar-looking rooms (e.g., Brownstone High School). Place equipment in a suspected room and check for it in the reflection.

Tarot Cards.effect: A deck of 10 cards drawn randomly from 10 types.

The Fool.effect: Mimics another card at random (100% during a hunt).

The Devil.effect: Triggers a paranormal event toward the nearest player.

The Hermit.effect: Sends the ghost back to its favorite room for 1 minute.

The High Priestess.effect: Revives a dead player (or the next one to die).

The Hanged Man.effect: Instantly kills the one who drew it.

Tarot Cards.cursedHuntTrigger: The Death card triggers a cursed hunt. Drawing during a hunt always yields The Fool.
Tarot Cards.strategyNotes: About 34.9% of decks contain no Death card at all—the only cursed possession that can trigger no hunt whatsoever. Once all 10 cards are drawn, every subsequent hunt still gains 20 seconds.

Summoning Circle.effect: Lighting all five candles summons the ghost and triggers a cursed hunt.
Summoning Circle.cursedHuntTrigger: Lighting all five candles always triggers a cursed hunt.
Summoning Circle.strategyNotes: One of the most direct and dangerous cursed possessions. Use Sanity Pills before lighting the final candle to ensure you have enough sanity to escape.
